info.title: Azure Databricks Custom
info.description: Azure Databricks connector with no workspace details to enter. Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID and run SQL, browse Unity Catalog, start jobs, and ask Genie spaces questions. The workspace host is set once when the connector is deployed, and the SQL warehouse is picked from a list or chosen automatically. Includes an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio.
